messages:
Ivy: heads-up — publish blocked by regendiff on mobile-sample. changelog-generator bumped minor because reordered OpenAPI pieces were treated as new additions.
Noah: can you paste the tiny diff? hoping it9s just order noise.
Ivy: yeah, snippet:
```
- components/schemas/DeviceInfo.yaml
- components/schemas/UserProfile.yaml
+ components/schemas/UserProfile.yaml
+ components/schemas/DeviceInfo.yaml
```
Ivy: Also saw a flaky integration that temporarily mutates global retry.defaults in one test path so typegen output toggles a default value. two noise sources.
regen-bot: regendiff job #4821: 2 files ordering-only, 1 file content drift (tests/integration/retry-leak.spec.js). deterministic: false
Priya: short-term mitigation options: 1) add a deterministic-serialize flag to the regen job to canonicalize maps before emit, 2) change semver guard to ignore ordering-only diffs, 3) add a changelog filter to drop reorder-only hunks.
Noah: please do 1+2 for the hotfix. I'll take 3 as follow-up.
Ivy: which command do we run in CI?
Noah: CI uses `yarn regen:mobile --ci`. I'll update it to `yarn regen:mobile --ci --deterministic-serialize` and relax the semver guard rule so ordering-only regendiffs don9t auto-bump.
Priya: repro steps I used locally:
1) checkout branch
2) yarn install
3) NODE_ENV=ci yarn regen:mobile
4) observe `git status` show reordered files
Priya: with `--deterministic-serialize` the output is stable.
semver-bot: release-gate scan: previous run would have bumped minor due to changelog line "Added UserProfile path"; new rule treating ordering-only as no-semver will prevent bump.
Noah: pushed hotfix branch regen/ci-deterministic and updated gate to ignore ordering-only diffs. CI re-run queued.
ci-bot: build #4822: regen job re-run -> PASSED (no regendiff)
Ivy: great. Priya, can you open a PR to fix the flaky retry test so it doesn't mutate globals? add an afterEach restore or clone the config.
Priya: PR #867 opened: test fix + a unit that runs regen 10x to assert identical output, plus a tiny changelog note.
Noah: merged CI hotfix and gate change. filing follow-ups: DEX-3030 (upstream parser deterministic traversal) and DEX-3031 (changelog-generator: canonicalize before diff).
Ivy: adding a short onboarding blurb: "If initial regen shows diffs, re-run with `NODE_ENV=ci yarn regen:mobile --deterministic-serialize` and open a regendiff ticket if it persists."
regen-bot: PR scan: changelog entry present; semver impact: none.
ci-bot: build #4825: full pipeline PASSED
Ivy: closing once PR lands. thanks all :tada:
